# Script API

Every module, function and constant a script can reach. Read from a booted
engine rather than the source, so derived constants are included and this
cannot drift from what scripts actually see. A node's own operations are
the `node` module's, called on the node: `self.node.add_tag("hit")`.

## `apple`

Apple services beyond `platform.*`: Game Center `identity`, purchases, notifications. Calls answer `task::wait` on a later tick as a map whose `kind` is an `EVENT_*` constant. What arrives unasked is the `apple_event` event, `events::listen(node, "apple_event")`: a notification tapped or shown in front, a push and its payload, a URL opened, an invite, an iCloud change, a transaction that landed elsewhere.

## `audio`

Sound playback: `play` starts a node's `sound` component and returns a handle that `stop_playback`, `set_volume_linear`, `set_pitch_scale` and `is_playing` take; `seek` and `skip` move it. `play_cue` plays a sound named in `audio/cues.toml`, from a `position` heard from the `listener` when given one. A node's `sound` announces `finished` (`EVENT_FINISHED`) with the handle when it plays out. `devices` lists the outputs `[audio] device` can name.

## `dependency`

The projects a game imports whole under `deps/<alias>/`, declared in `[dependencies]`. An installed dependency is read-only: `fs.*` and `assets.save` refuse to write into one. A relative path a dependency's script builds reads from that dependency's own folder.

## `http`

HTTP requests off the frame: `method`, `headers`, `body`, `timeout_seconds` and `save_to` options. `task::wait` on the id answers a map whose `kind` is `response`, with `status`, `headers` and `body`, or `error`; a `save_to` download reports as the `http_progress` event with `kind` `progress`, and a body over 256 KB going out with `kind` `upload`, natively; a browser's fetch does not report one. Each kind is an `EVENT_*` constant.

| Function | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `(int) -> bool` |
| `request` | `(str, http::RequestOptions?) -> int` |

## `platform`

Store services every platform shares: sign-in, achievements, leaderboards, cloud saves. A call answers `task::wait` later with a map whose `kind` is `signed_in`, `signed_out`, `done`, `scores`, `read`, `error` or `unsupported`, each an `EVENT_*` constant. ## `websocket`

A long-lived socket for text or binary frames. Events reach the node's `on_websocket_event` (or `on_event`) as a map with `socket` and `kind`: `open`, `message`, `binary`, `closed` or `error`, each an `EVENT_*` constant. An `error` carries its `reason`, and the HTTP `status` when a server refused the upgrade.

| Function | Signature |
| --- | --- |
| `close` | `(int) -> bool` |
| `connect` | `(Node?, str, websocket::ConnectOptions?) -> int` |
| `send_bytes` | `(int, [int]) -> bool` |
| `send_text` | `(int, str) -> bool` |
| `state` | `(int) -> str` |

**Constants** (9):

| Name | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `EVENT_BINARY` | `"binary"` |
| `EVENT_CLOSED` | `"closed"` |
